From 8363c02863332992a1822688da41f881d88d1631 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lizhi Hou <lizhi.hou@amd.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 22:03:06 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] accel/amdxdna: Fix crash when destroying a suspended hardware
 context

If userspace issues an ioctl to destroy a hardware context that has
already been automatically suspended, the driver may crash because the
mailbox channel pointer is NULL for the suspended context.

Fix this by checking the mailbox channel pointer in aie2_destroy_context()
before accessing it.

Fixes: 97f27573837e ("accel/amdxdna: Fix potential NULL pointer dereference in context cleanup")
Reviewed-by: Karol Wachowski <karol.wachowski@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Lizhi Hou <lizhi.hou@amd.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260206060306.4050531-1-lizhi.hou@amd.com

diff --git a/drivers/accel/amdxdna/aie2_message.c b/drivers/accel/amdxdna/aie2_message.c
index 7d7dcfeaf794..ab1178850c47 100644
--- a/drivers/accel/amdxdna/aie2_message.c
+++ b/drivers/accel/amdxdna/aie2_message.c
@@ -318,6 +318,9 @@ int aie2_destroy_context(struct amdxdna_dev_hdl *ndev, struct amdxdna_hwctx *hwc
 	struct amdxdna_dev *xdna = ndev->xdna;
 	int ret;
 
+	if (!hwctx->priv->mbox_chann)
+		return 0;
+
 	xdna_mailbox_stop_channel(hwctx->priv->mbox_chann);
 	ret = aie2_destroy_context_req(ndev, hwctx->fw_ctx_id);
 	xdna_mailbox_destroy_channel(hwctx->priv->mbox_chann);
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### Modifications in Each File

- **`drivers/accel/amdxdna/aie2_message.c`**  
  Added a conditional check for `hwctx->priv->mbox_chann` being `NULL` at the beginning of the `aie2_destroy_context()` function. If the pointer is `NULL`, the function returns `0` immediately, skipping the subsequent mailbox operations (stop, destroy, request) that would otherwise dereference the null pointer and cause a crash.

### Relationships Between Modifications

This single change directly addresses the root cause of the crash: when a hardware context is automatically suspended, its associated mailbox channel is not initialized (pointer is `NULL`). Previously, `aie2_destroy_context()` unconditionally called functions like `xdna_mailbox_stop_channel()` on the potentially null `mbox_chann`, leading to a NULL pointer dereference. The added guard ensures that for suspended contexts (indicated by a null mailbox channel), the cleanup is skipped entirely, preventing the crash while still allowing a safe early return.

Here is the commit message:
accel/amdxdna: Fix crash when destroying a suspended hardware
 context

If userspace issues an ioctl to destroy a hardware context that has
already been automatically suspended, the driver may crash because the
mailbox channel pointer is NULL for the suspended context.

Fix this by checking the mailbox channel pointer in aie2_destroy_context()
before accessing it.

Fixes: 97f27573837e ("accel/amdxdna: Fix potential NULL pointer dereference in context cleanup")
Reviewed-by: Karol Wachowski <karol.wachowski@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Lizhi Hou <lizhi.hou@amd.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260206060306.4050531-1-lizhi.hou@amd.com

Here is the root cause:
When a hardware context is automatically suspended, its mailbox channel pointer (`hwctx->priv->mbox_chann`) is set to NULL. The `aie2_destroy_context()` function then attempts to use this NULL pointer (e.g., in `xdna_mailbox_stop_channel()`) without checking, causing a NULL pointer dereference and system crash.

Here is the patch:
 
 int aie2_destroy_context(struct amdxdna_dev_hdl *ndev, struct amdxdna_hwctx *hwctx)
 {
 	struct amdxdna_dev *xdna = ndev->xdna;
 	int ret;
 
+	if (!hwctx->priv->mbox_chann)
+		return 0;
+
 	xdna_mailbox_stop_channel(hwctx->priv->mbox_chann);
 	ret = aie2_destroy_context_req(ndev, hwctx->fw_ctx_id);
 	xdna_mailbox_destroy_channel(hwctx->priv->mbox_chann);
 	XDNA_DBG(xdna, "Destroyed fw ctx %d", hwctx->fw_ctx_id);
 	hwctx->priv->mbox_chann = NULL;
 	hwctx->fw_ctx_id = -1;
 	ndev->hwctx_num--;
 
 	return ret;
 }
